 %% ==================== HELPER PACKAGE ====================
 class Capability {
 <<enumeration>>
 SCIENTIFIC_RESEARCH
 EQUIPMENT_REPAIR
 MEDICAL_CARE
 SURFACE_EXPLORATION
 AERIAL_RECON
 COMMUNICATION
 FIRE_RESPONSE
 RESCUE
 }

 class EmergencyState {
 <<enumeration>>
 TRIGGERED
 RESOLVED
 UNRESOLVED
 }

 class EnvironmentCondition {
 <<enumeration>>
 NORMAL
 DUST_STORM
 COMMUNICATION_DISRUPTION
 }

 class MissionState {
 <<enumeration>>
 ASSIGNED
 IN_PROGRESS
 COMPLETED
 FAILED
 }

 class ResourceType {
 <<enumeration>>
 OXYGEN
 WATER
 FOOD
 FUEL
 BATTERY_POWER
 MEDICAL_SUPPLIES
 SPARE_PARTS
 }

 class Equipment {
 -String name
 -Capability providedCapability
 -boolean damaged
 -int usageNumber
 -boolean available
 +Equipment(String, Capability)
 +createSpectrometer()$ Equipment
 +createMicroscope()$ Equipment
 +createRepairToolkit()$ Equipment
 +createWeldingTorch()$ Equipment
 +createMedicalScanner()$ Equipment
 +createSurgicalKit()$ Equipment
 +createAntennaArray()$ Equipment
 +createDroneControlTerminal()$ Equipment
 +createFireExtinguisher()$ Equipment
 +useIt() boolean
 +fixIt() void
 +isAvailable() boolean
 +isDamaged() boolean
 }

 %% ==================== ENVIRONMENT PACKAGE ====================
 class Environment {
 -EnvironmentCondition environmentCondition$
 +Environment()
 +setCondition(EnvironmentCondition) void
 +setState(EnvironmentCondition)$ void
 +changeState() void
 +getState()$ EnvironmentCondition
 }

 %% ==================== AGENT PACKAGE ====================
 class Agent {
 <<abstract>>
 -String name
 -String id
 #int healthStatus
 #boolean availability
 -boolean onMission
 -String location
 #Set~Capability~ capabilities
 +Agent(String, String, String)
 #updateAvailability()* void
 +takeDamage(int) boolean
 +restoreHealth(int) boolean
 +isHuman()* boolean
 +isRobot()* boolean
 +canPerform(Mission) boolean
 +canHandle(Capability) boolean
 }

 class CrewMember {
 <<abstract>>
 -int fatigueLevel
 +CrewMember(String, String, String)
 +increaseFatigue(int) boolean
 +rest(int) boolean
 +eat(Habitat, int) boolean
 +drink(Habitat, int) boolean
 #updateAvailability() void
 +isHuman() boolean
 +isRobot() boolean
 }

 class RoboticUnit {
 <<abstract>>
 -int batteryLevel
 +RoboticUnit(String, String, String)
 +discharge(int) boolean
 +charge(PowerStation, int) boolean
 #updateAvailability() void
 +isHuman() boolean
 +isRobot() boolean
 }

 class Vehicle {
 <<abstract>>
 +Vehicle(String, String, String)
 }

 class Engineer {
 -int nextId$
 +Engineer()
 +Engineer(String, String)
 }

 class MedicalOfficer {
 -int nextId$
 +MedicalOfficer()
 +MedicalOfficer(String, String)
 }

 class Scientist {
 -int nextId$
 +Scientist()
 +Scientist(String, String)
 }

 class RepairRobot {
 -int nextId$
 +RepairRobot()
 +RepairRobot(String, String)
 }

 class ExplorationRover {
 -int nextId$
 -List~Equipment~ carriedEquipment
 +ExplorationRover()
 +ExplorationRover(String, String)
 +loadEquipment(Equipment) boolean
 +unloadEquipment(Equipment) boolean
 +getCarriedEquipment() List~Equipment~
 }

 class Drone {
 -int nextId$
 +Drone()
 +Drone(String, String)
 }

 %% ==================== FACILITY PACKAGE ====================
 class Facility {
 <<abstract>>
 -String location
 -int currentOccupancy
 -int capacity
 -boolean isOperational
 -List~Equipment~ equipments
 #Map~ResourceType, Integer~ resources
 #int maxResources
 #int POWER_COST$
 +Facility(String, int, int, int, Equipment[])
 +addOccupiers() boolean
 +removeOccupiers() boolean
 +addResource(ResourceType, int) boolean
 +deductResource(ResourceType, int) int
 +transferResourceTo(Facility, ResourceType, int) boolean
 +useResources()* boolean
 }

 class LifeSupportSystem {
 -int filtrationRate
 -boolean isFunctional
 +LifeSupportSystem(int)
 +getFiltrationRate() int
 +isFunctional() boolean
 +setFunctional(boolean) void
 }

 class Habitat {
 -LifeSupportSystem lifeSupport
 +Habitat()
 +useResources() boolean
 +getLifeSupport() LifeSupportSystem
 }

 class Laboratory {
 -boolean hasFire
 +Laboratory()
 +useResources() boolean
 +hasFire() boolean
 +setHasFire(boolean) void
 }

 class PowerStation {
 -int chargingRate
 +PowerStation()
 +generatePower() boolean
 +useResources() boolean
 }

 class StorageFacilities {
 +StorageFacilities()
 +useResources() boolean
 }

 class CommunicationStation {
 +CommunicationStation()
 +changeOperationalStatus(Environment) void
 +useResources() boolean
 }

 %% ==================== MISSION PACKAGE ====================
 class Mission {
 <<abstract>>
 #Colony colony
 #String missionId
 -String description
 -MissionState status
 -String location
 #ResourceType[] resources
 #int requiredDuration
 #int timeElapsed
 #String failureReason
 #Equipment equipment
 #List~Agent~ assignedAgents
 +Mission(Colony, String, String, ResourceType[], Equipment, int)
 +submitMission()* boolean
 +startMission() boolean
 +progress(int) void
 +isCompleted() boolean
 +fail(String) void
 +complete() void
 #endMission(MissionState) void
 }

 class ExplorationMission {
 -Agent crewMember
 -Vehicle vehicle
 -double requiredBatteryLevel
 +ExplorationMission(...)
 +submitMission() boolean
 +startMission() boolean
 +endMission(MissionState) void
 }

 class RepairMission {
 -Agent engineer
 -Agent repairRobot
 -Facility targetFacility
 -Equipment targetEquipment
 +RepairMission(...)
 +submitMission() boolean
 +startMission() boolean
 +endMission(MissionState) void
 }

 class ResearchMission {
 -Agent scientist
 -Laboratory laboratory
 -String experimentName
 +ResearchMission(...)
 +submitMission() boolean
 +startMission() boolean
 +endMission(MissionState) void
 }

 class RescueMission {
 -Agent personnel
 -Vehicle vehicle
 -CommunicationStation communicationStation
 +RescueMission(...)
 +submitMission() boolean
 +startMission() boolean
 +endMission(MissionState) void
 }

 %% ==================== EMERGENCY PACKAGE ====================
 class Emergency {
 <<abstract>>
 #String emergencyId
 #String location
 #String description
 #Capability[] requiredCapabilities
 #EmergencyState emergencyState
 #String failureReason
 #Emergency(String, String, Capability[])
 +handle(Colony)* boolean
 }

 class OxygenLeak {
 -Habitat affectedHabitat
 -int leakAmount$
 +OxygenLeak(Habitat)
 +handle(Colony) boolean
 }

 class Fire {
 -Laboratory affectedLaboratory
 +Fire(Laboratory)
 +handle(Colony) boolean
 }

 class RoverBreakdown {
 -ExplorationRover damagedRover
 -String breakdownLocation
 +RoverBreakdown(ExplorationRover)
 +handle(Colony) boolean
 }

 class MedicalEmergency {
 -CrewMember patient
 -Habitat medicalHabitat
 +MedicalEmergency(CrewMember, Habitat)
 +handle(Colony) boolean
 }

 %% ==================== COLONY PACKAGE ====================
 class Colony {
 -List~Agent~ agents
 -List~Facility~ facilities
 -Mission activeMission
 -Environment environment
 -int currentTime
 -List~Emergency~ emergencyHistory
 -List~Mission~ missionHistory
 -Colony()
 +setupColony()$ Colony
 +addAgent(Agent) void
 +addAgents(Agent...) void
 +addFacility(Facility) void
 +getTotalResource(ResourceType) int
 +checkAvailableResources(ResourceType[], int) boolean
 +deductResource(ResourceType, int) boolean
 +checkAvailableEquipment(Equipment) boolean
 +submitMission(Mission) boolean
 +startActiveMission() boolean
 +advanceTime(int) void
 +triggerEmergency(Emergency) boolean
 +generateStatusReport() String
 }

 %% ==================== INHERITANCE RELATIONSHIPS ====================
 Agent <|-- CrewMember
 Agent <|-- RoboticUnit
 CrewMember <|-- Engineer
 CrewMember <|-- MedicalOfficer
 CrewMember <|-- Scientist
 RoboticUnit <|-- RepairRobot
 RoboticUnit <|-- Vehicle
 Vehicle <|-- ExplorationRover
 Vehicle <|-- Drone

 Facility <|-- Habitat
 Facility <|-- Laboratory
 Facility <|-- PowerStation
 Facility <|-- StorageFacilities
 Facility <|-- CommunicationStation

 Mission <|-- ExplorationMission
 Mission <|-- RepairMission
 Mission <|-- ResearchMission
 Mission <|-- RescueMission

 Emergency <|-- OxygenLeak
 Emergency <|-- Fire
 Emergency <|-- RoverBreakdown
 Emergency <|-- MedicalEmergency

 %% ==================== COMPOSITION RELATIONSHIPS ====================
 Habitat \"1\" *-- \"1\" LifeSupportSystem : owns >
 Colony \"1\" *-- \"1\" Environment : manages >

 %% ==================== AGGREGATION RELATIONSHIPS ====================
 Colony \"1\" o-- \"0..*\" Agent : manages >
 Colony \"1\" o-- \"1..*\" Facility : contains >
 Facility \"1\" o-- \"0..*\" Equipment : stores >
 ExplorationRover \"1\" o-- \"0..*\" Equipment : carries >

 %% ==================== ASSOCIATION RELATIONSHIPS ====================
 Colony \"1\" --> \"0..1\" Mission : activeMission >
 Colony \"1\" --> \"0..*\" Mission : missionHistory >
 Colony \"1\" --> \"0..*\" Emergency : emergencyHistory >
 Mission \"0..*\" --> \"1..*\" Agent : assigns >
 Mission \"0..*\" --> \"0..1\" Equipment : uses >
 OxygenLeak --> \"1\" Habitat : affects >
 Fire --> \"1\" Laboratory : affects >
 RoverBreakdown --> \"1\" ExplorationRover : damages >
 MedicalEmergency --> \"1\" CrewMember : treats >
 MedicalEmergency --> \"1\" Habitat : uses >",
